Subject: UCSF Labs: Next steps & priority mapping for webinar attendees

Team —

Great session with UCSF Labs this morning. Quick stitch of what I pulled from the attendee exports and what I need from ops + SDRs to close the loop this week: 

1) Attendee reconciliation: attached is the raw CSV from the platform (ucsf-attendee-list.csv). I flagged 142 registrants, 88 live attendees, and 42 who watched the replay. We should dedupe by email and map to HubSpot contact ids.

2) MQL thresholds — proposal:
   - High-touch (A): attended live + org size > 500 or title contains "Director/Head/VP"
   - Warm (B): engaged (asked a question or stayed >45m) or downloaded slide deck
   - Nurture (C): replay viewers and registrants who did not attend

3) Routing: suggest Marissa own A accounts (high-touch), Sean route B accounts into the SDR queue with 48h SLA, Neha to own nurture cadence (email series + content).

4) Outreach assets: need the replay link and a one-pager tailored to med/academic labs. I'll draft the first outreach but want to be clear on assignments.

Ask: Sean, can you confirm HubSpot list ids and automate the queueing? Marissa, can you confirm you'll take ownership of A accounts and if you need any special prep? Neha, can you share a suggested nurture cadence (3 emails) by EOD Friday?

Attachments: ucsf-attendee-list.csv (CSV, 88 live attendees, 42 replay)

Thanks —
Priyom

Hey all —

I pulled the HubSpot exports and created two lists. HubSpot list ids: 9876 (UCSF-Webinar-Live-Attendees) and 9877 (UCSF-Webinar-Replay). I've attached a starter mapping (ucsf-priority-mapping.xlsx) that joins attendee email -> hs_contact_id -> suggested queue (A/B/C).

Notes on thresholds I used (open to tweaks):
- A (High-touch): title contains "Director|Head|VP|Professor|PI" OR institution contains "UCSF" AND attended live.
- B (Warm): attended live and engaged (q&a or >45m) OR downloaded materials.
- C (Nurture): replay viewers or registrants who did not attend.

Automation: I can push list 9876 into the "SDR_A_Queue" workflow which will assign to Marissa and send a Slack alert. For 9877 I can add to Neha's nurture list and schedule a drip starting 11/09.

Attachment: ucsf-priority-mapping.xlsx (XLSX)

I will also create a HubSpot task template for the 48h call attempt. Let me know if you want different ownership or additional segmentation (PI vs lab manager).

—Sean
